name: Mag_OS — Vine Certificate — Payment Processing v1

parameters.jsCode: const p=$json.body??$json; const required=['order_id','client_name','email','certificate_name','amount','payment_status']; const missing=required.filter(k=>p[k]===undefined||String(p[k]).trim()===''); if(missing.length) throw new Error('VALIDATION_ERROR:'+missing.join(',')); if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(String(p.email))) throw new Error('VALIDATION_ERROR:email'); if(Number(p.amount)<=0) throw new Error('VALIDATION_ERROR:amount'); const order_id=String(p.order_id).trim(); const paid=String(p.payment_status).toLowerCase()==='paid'; const date=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replaceAll('-',''); const random=Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(); return [{json:{...p,order_id,paid,certificate_code:`VINE-${order_id.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g,'')}-${date}-${random}`,received_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO vine_certificate_service.orders (order_id,client_name,email,certificate_name,amount,payment_status,certificate_code,certificate_link,processing_status,pdf_status,email_status) VALUES ('{{$json.order_id}}','{{$json.client_name}}','{{$json.email}}','{{$json.certificate_name}}',{{$json.amount}},'paid','{{$json.certificate_code}}','local://vine-certificates/{{$json.certificate_code}}.pdf','completed','generated','pending') ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now() RETURNING order_id,certificate_code,certificate_link,processing_status;
